title: Copper Sunrise
description: Sun medallions in copper and gold on deep earth brown. A warm palette for headwraps and statement wrappers.

title: Lake Bangweulu Indigo
description: Layered ripples in indigo and sky blue, inspired by the waters of Lake Bangweulu.

title: Wedding Garden
description: Soft ivory with pink and red blooms: a celebration palette for matching wedding outfits.

title: Ceremony Geometry
description: Red, white and black diamonds with gold centres. Bold geometry inspired by ceremonial dress.

title: Market Day Stripes
description: Colour-blocked stripes and checks in green, orange and yellow, like a busy market stall.

title: Night Sky Stars
description: Gold stars on a midnight blue ground. Playful enough for children, elegant enough for evening wear.

title: Baobab Leaf Study
description: Leaf forms in green and gold on rich brown, drawn from the shapes of the baobab.

title: Cowrie Coast
description: Cream cowrie shells on teal. A symbol of prosperity, reimagined as a modern repeat.

title: Earth and Clay
description: Mark-making in cream on terracotta, inspired by mud-cloth and clay pottery.

title: Colour Block City
description: Playful purple, pink and yellow shapes. A contemporary look for city fashion.
